aawt.midnightconfig.title: Axes Are Weapons Too Settings
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.aawt: Turns the axe into a proper weapon with its own enchantments.
aawt.midnightconfig.knockbackSuppression: Knockback resistance multiplier for axes. Ignores enchantments. A value of 0.4 matches a full set of netherite armour.
aawt.midnightconfig.playerHeadNaming.too: %username% is the victim, %killer% the attacker, %uuid% the UUID of the victim; a translation key in the template becomes text in the language of whoever reads the name. Built-in key: aawt.head_naming.head_of. Empty keeps the vanilla name.
aawt.midnightconfig.playerHeadLore.toolt: Template of the description line under the head's name. %username% is the victim, %killer% the attacker, %uuid% the UUID of the victim; a translation key in the template becomes text in the language of whoever hovers. Built-in keys: aawt.head_description.killed_by, aawt.head_description.chopped_by, aawt.head_description.dynamic (vanilla's "Dynamic" line). Empty removes both the description and "Dynamic".
enchantment.aawt.beheading.desc: A mob or player killed with an axe may drop their head.
enchantment.aawt.cleaving.desc: An axe hit that breaks a shield ignores part of its protection. Also keeps the shield disabled for longer.
